suite.name: Showtime Suite
suite.tagline: Free tools for live shows: playback, presentations, projection, planning and network monitoring. One launcher installs, updates and starts them.
features: One card per app: installed version, newest release, Install, Update, Open and what is new.
Downloads come from each app's GitHub releases and are checked against their SHA-256.
A running app is never replaced: a show may be going on.
All apps go into one folder: Programs › Showtime Suite on the Mac, your own user folder on Windows and Linux, no admin rights needed.

apps.name: Show Master
apps.tagline: Cue-based show control: audio playback, MIDI, OSC, timecode and tablet remote.
apps.intro: The cue list for theatre, events, installations and concerts. GO fires the next cue: audio with fades, MIDI, OSC, HTTP and timecode, all from one list. Runs completely offline.
features: Cue list with playhead
GO fires the cue at the playhead and moves on. Groups, wait times, follow-ons and loops.
Every kind of cue
Audio, fades, MIDI (with SysEx and MSC), OSC to desks and other tools, HTTP, timecode and control cues.
Timecode
LTC as audio, MTC and RTP-MIDI at the same time; cues can fire at timecode times.
Tablet remote
Open showmaster.local on a phone or iPad: a view, a remote with GO and Panic, and a stage display. Pair with a QR code.
Edit and Live
Build the show in Edit mode with waveform and routing matrix; Live mode is read-only with big buttons.
Backup computer
A second computer with the same show follows along and takes over.
Show packages
Show and all audio files in one file; cue sheets as PDF or CSV.

apps.name: Lantern
apps.tagline: Presentation playback for live shows: PowerPoint, GO or timecode, display and NDI.
apps.intro: Plays PowerPoint files on a display and over NDI, slide by slide with GO or on timecode. It is a playback tool, not an editor: make the presentation in PowerPoint, Keynote or LibreOffice.
features: PowerPoint as it looks
Every slide rendered in the output resolution. Also .ppt, .odp, .key and plain PDFs.
Live layout
Slide list with thumbnails, LIVE and NEXT, big GO and GO back, blackout, notes and clocks.
Builds
Shapes and bullet points that come with a click in PowerPoint come with GO, step by step.
GO or timecode
Trigger with a button, a clicker, OSC or Show Master, or at timecode keyframes (LTC, MTC, RTP-MIDI).
Outputs
Full screen on any display, on several at once, and as an NDI source. A test picture for setting up.
Stage display
Time, countdown, messages, the slide now and next and the notes, on a display, over NDI or in a browser.
Web remote and show log
A remote page for a phone; every cue logged with time of day and timecode.

apps.name: Beamweave
apps.tagline: Projection mapping, LED pixel mapping and NDI.
apps.intro: Map video onto any surface, line up several projectors in one 3D room, and drive LED strips from the same picture.
features: Surfaces
Quads with correct perspective, triangles, ellipses, grid warps up to 12×12 and polygon masks.
Sources
Video files with sound, cameras and capture cards, images, NDI inputs, live-editable shaders and colours.
Several projectors
Each with its own resolution, corner correction and soft edges for overlaps.
3D room
Projectors and surfaces share one room, so several projectors line up on the same place.
LED pixel mapping
Strips and matrices sample the picture and go out as Art-Net or sACN.
NDI out
Any stage can be published as an NDI source on the network.
Control
MIDI learn, OSC, keyboard and scenes with fades; undo, autosave and a manual.

apps.name: Blueprint
apps.tagline: Planning: mic plots, setlists, patch plans and more.
apps.intro: Plans for live shows, from one project file: mic plots for theatre and musicals, setlists, patch plans across several locations and more, everything printable as a clean PDF.
features: One project per production
Cast, roles with their casting, scenes, transmitters and locations. Change a name in one place.
Tables like a spreadsheet
Keyboard first, several rows at once, drag to reorder, copy and paste with Excel or Numbers.
Mic plan
Scene × transmitter matrix, swaps, casts of the day, spares in one click, DCAs, batteries, frequencies and checks for every clash.
Setlists
A song library, breaks and encores, times of day, printed on one page as large as fits.
Patch
Devices, multicores and network lines, input and output patch with the whole signal path, cables and stands counted.
More plans
Stage plot from a symbol library, run of show, contacts, packing list, intercom plan and free tables.
Prints and exchange
PDFs with embedded fonts, revisions with change marks, CSV and spreadsheet import, an exchange file for Pulse and the other tools.

apps.name: Pulse
apps.tagline: Network and device monitor: one traffic light for the show's technology.
apps.intro: Checks before and during the show that the desk, stageboxes, NDI sources, Art-Net and sACN universes, tablets, show computers and the network are there and healthy, and turns all of it into one traffic light with the reasons.
apps.extra_note: Pulse Agent is a small read-only helper for show computers: CPU, memory, free disk and whether the show programs run.
features: One light
Green, yellow or red, with the reason in plain words, per area and overall. Calm, with hysteresis and acknowledgements.
Checks that only ask
Ping without admin rights, TCP ports, console queries, Art-Net and sACN universes, Dante and NDI, switch ports over SNMP.
19 presets
X32 / M32, X Air, Wing, Soundcraft Si, grandMA3, Dante, NDI, Art-Net, sACN, switches, show computers and more.
CHECK, SHOW, DIAGNOSE
Set up and check; a quiet view for the show with a separate light window; graphs, hints, port test and traceroute for one device.
Pre-show check
Every check once, sign-off with your name, a report as HTML and CSV.
Status page
A read-only view for phones of the crew in the same network.
From Blueprint
Take over the devices of a Blueprint project, with presets from their model.
